description: This file defines the 'LibraryTypes' class which encapsulates type information and reflection-based type analysis for the Orleans code generator. It includes methods for determining shallow copyability of types, and maintains references to various important types and attributes used in Orleans serialization and code generation.

classes.name: LibraryTypes
classes.description: A class that encapsulates type information and reflection logic for Orleans code generation, including type references, attribute handling, and shallow copyability checks.

methods.name: FromCompilation
methods.description: Creates an instance of LibraryTypes from a Roslyn Compilation and code generator options.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Determines if a given type is shallow copyable based on its attributes, type kind, and known shallow copyable types.

methods.name: IsValueTypeFieldsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Checks if all fields of a value type are shallow copyable.

methods.name: AreShallowCopyable
methods.description: Overloaded methods to check if a collection of types or fields are shallow copyable.
